proposition: Requirement 7.2 tells the agent at Close to write a removed file's summary 'into the record or the spec', and 7 lets it rewrite a cited_in_record citation in the same edit. Removing a non-spec file does not move the review-policy receipt (review_policy.policy_input_snapshot hashes only admitted change bodies through canonical_review_policy_body, plus config; run_tests._hash_inputs hashes only the framework tree), which settles the plan's 'inferred' as true for removal. But a spec edit outside the Progress Log does move the digest, and lifecycle_gates.shared_delivery_gate (CLOSE_SHARED_GATES) calls _review_policy_receipt_diagnostics non-advisory, so Close then returns review_policy_receipt_stale and demands re-Prepare of an implemented wave.

command_or_fixture: python3 -B -I probe.py docs/waves (scratch census: re.escape(rel) + right lookahead, then check preceding char)
counterexample_or_failure_condition: Close of 22bs0 after reopen reports delivery-evidence.json as cited_in_ledger or cited_in_record from an unrelated name, so the agent keeps it without a disposition line.
expected: a match only where the relative path starts at a path boundary
known_bad_detection_method: executed census found real false matches in 22bs0 and 1y0h2
limitations: Census used text of top-level .md files and events.jsonl only; composes with red-team READY-P9T-NAME-CITE (name-only citations), whose fix would widen this exposure.
observed: left-boundary false matches: 4; repo-relative citations: 145
proposition: Requirement 4 bounds a citation match only on the right ('the character after it does not continue the path'); the left side is undefined, so a relative path matches inside any longer name that ends with it. Executed census over docs/waves with the right boundary only: 4 false matches, including 22bs0 initiative-continuity where loose delivery-evidence.json (a legacy typed file the operator decision names) reads cited from 'arc-delivery-evidence.json', and 1y0h2 where delivery-freeze.json reads cited from '/tmp/handler-delivery-freeze.json'. A false cited_in_ledger is 'always kept' and hides the file from disposition. The same census found 145 citations written repo-relative ('docs/waves/<folder>/<rel>', folder names contain spaces), so a strict left boundary that rejects '/' would mark those not_cited. The right rule is also unstated for a trailing sentence period, which must end a path while '.bak' must continue it (AC-2).
public_path: plan req 4 and AC-2 applied to real record texts
safety_and_authorization: read-only scratch script; no repository writes

disposition_rationale: Smallest fix: req 4 states both boundaries: the match starts at the start of the text or after a character that is not a name or path character, or immediately after the record folder's own repo-relative prefix 'docs/waves/<folder name>/'; it ends at end of text or before a character that is not a name character, a final '.' counting as an end. AC-2 adds the left case (a.json against a cited data.json) and the repo-relative form as cited.
